name: Lazarus MedCore Surgical Scrub Set
description:
The MedCore scrub set is the standard surgical uniform across Lazarus-affiliated hospitals and private clinics throughout GLMZ. The fabric is a tightly bonded synthetic-cellulose blend rated for Class 4 biohazard splash resistance, with a micro-textured surface that actively prevents bacterial adhesion through a low-level electrostatic charge sustained by the wearer's body heat. The scrubs come in Lazarus's signature pale blue-green — a color chosen in the 2140s for its effect on patient stress responses — with the Lazarus caduceus printed in white at the left shoulder. Port access panels at the forearm and neck accommodate BCI hardline connections used during augment-adjacent surgical procedures, where the surgeon's neural interface must sync with the patient's chrome.

The MedCore set is designed with geneware accommodation as a baseline feature: the waistband includes a pre-cut tail slot reinforced with sealed edging, the hood option has molded horn-clearance inserts, and the fabric's stretch coefficient is high enough to accommodate fur-bearing limbs without restricting circulation. Lazarus supplies these scrubs at subsidized rates to licensed practitioners but sells them commercially to clinics operating outside the Lazarus network — at a significantly higher markup. In underfunded Tier 1 and 2 clinics, worn-out MedCore scrubs held together with nano-adhesive patches are a common sight, second and third owners of a garment meant to last one surgical rotation.
cultural_context: The pale blue-green of Lazarus scrubs is one of the most universally recognized colors in M88. In Tier 1 zones where Lazarus clinics operate on skeleton budgets, a person in MedCore scrubs commands a kind of informal authority — they're someone who can help. In higher tiers, the same scrubs might mark someone as overworked, underpaid, or both.
story_hooks: A Shelf surgeon is performing unlicensed augment procedures using legitimate Lazarus scrubs and equipment — Lazarus wants the practice shut down, but the community the surgeon serves has no other options.
A batch of MedCore scrubs distributed to a Tier 1 clinic has an anomalous electrostatic signature — someone has modified the anti-bacterial charge to also disrupt nearby diagnostic equipment.
A patient recognizes their surgeon's scrubs as the same set worn during a procedure they have no memory of — a procedure not listed in their medical record.

physical_description.visual_profile: A clinical yet functionally augmented surgical uniform in Lazarus's iconic pale blue-green. The silhouette is slightly loose through the torso to accommodate varied body types and geneware, with visible reinforced port access panels at the forearms and neck. The white caduceus at the left shoulder is immediately recognizable across the GLMZ. Overall impression: medical authority mixed with the worn familiarity of working-class utility.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through the chest and abdomen with tapered sleeves; high stretch coefficient accommodates both baseline humans and geneware-bearing bodies without restriction. Waistband sits mid-hip with reinforced tail slot edging visible. The fabric moves with the body rather than constraining it — designed for 12+ hour surgical rotations.
physical_description.primary_material: Synthetic-cellulose blend, Class 4 biohazard rated. Micro-textured surface with integrated low-level electrostatic charge sustained by body heat. Fabric weight suggests durability but not bulk.
physical_description.texture: Micro-textured surface with subtle grid pattern visible under direct light — tactile grip prevents slipping during high-stakes procedures. Seams are reinforced with sealed edging. Port access panels show slightly raised borders with sealed gasket grooves. Overall feel: clinical precision with practical durability.
physical_description.color_scheme: Signature Lazarus pale blue-green (slightly desaturated, calming) across the entire set. White caduceus symbol printed at left shoulder. Reinforced panel borders in neutral gray or matching tone. On worn examples: visible nano-adhesive patches in slightly off-tone whites or grays.
physical_description.closures: Front zip or friction-fit magnetic snap closure (upper torso). Elastic waistband with drawstring at hip. Sleeve cuffs are fitted elastic. Neck opening accommodates hardline BCI port without gaping.
distinctive_features: Forearm port access panels with sealed gasket grooves for hardline neural connections
Neck port accommodation with molded insertion collar
Pre-cut, reinforced tail slot in waistband for geneware accommodation
Hood option with molded horn-clearance inserts (if full set)
Lazarus caduceus in white at left shoulder — universal medical authority symbol
Common sight: nano-adhesive patches at stress points on second/third-hand examples
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury (subsidized cost for licensed practitioners) / Tier 3-5 functional workwear (commercial markup or salvaged/patched versions). The same garment signals different economic realities depending on condition and context.
physical_description.cultural_context: Medical authority and working-class exhaustion. In Tier 1 zones, marks the wearer as healthcare provider — someone with informal social power. In higher tiers, signals overwork and underpayment. Universally recognized across GLMZ; wearing one outside medical context is unusual and raises questions. The pale blue-green is neurologically associated with patient calm — wearing it triggers subconsious trust responses.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine in Tier 1 subsidized settings (first rotation); broken-in and patched in understaffed clinics; weathered with visible nano-adhesive repairs in third-hand Tier 3-5 versions. Discoloration around seams common from repeated high-heat sterilization. Port access panels show friction wear from repeated hardline connections.

image_prompt: Fashion photography of a Lazarus MedCore surgical scrub set on a neo-noir model with visible subdermal implants along the neck and collarbone. The model wears the pale blue-green scrubs with the white caduceus visible at left shoulder; forearm port access panel is clearly rendered with micro-textured surface detail. Dark medical facility backdrop with blue-tinted ambient lighting casting subtle shadows. One version shows pristine Tier 1 condition; alternate shows weathered patches and nano-adhesive repairs.
